description:
Feeling overwhelmed by your health? Bearable is the symptom tracker that helps you work out what makes your symptoms, pain, migraine and mental health better or worse, so you can feel more in control. Join over 2M patients & doctors using Bearable to manage symptoms, pain, migraine, mood, medication and mental health.

FIND YOUR TRIGGERS
Most people arrive with one question: what is making my symptoms worse? Log how you feel in a few taps a day, and Bearable shows the correlations between your symptoms and your sleep, food, weather, stress, medication and habits, so you know which triggers to avoid.

NOT SURE WHERE TO START?
No diagnosis or plan needed. Rate how you feel, add a symptom or two, and Bearable suggests what to log next as your symptom diary grows.

PAIN, MIGRAINE AND HEADACHE TRACKER
Record pain levels, where the pain is and how long it lasts. Log migraine frequency and severity, spot the warning signs before a migraine attack, see which migraine treatments help, and learn which triggers reliably set off your headaches. The pain tracker is used every day by people managing chronic pain, migraine, arthritis, fibromyalgia, endometriosis, joint pain and back pain.

MENTAL HEALTH AND MOOD TRACKER
See whether your mental health is changing over time, not just how today feels. Log mood, energy, stress, sleep and anxiety alongside what is going on in your life, and see how work, exercise, social plans and the weather shape your mental health. The mental health tracker is used by people living with anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, ADHD and OCD, and by anyone wanting a clearer picture of their mental health.

CHRONIC ILLNESS, FATIGUE AND FLARE-UPS
Log flare-ups, pain, crashes and good days to see what leads to each. Work out which activities drain you or give you energy, and give your doctor a clear record of how your chronic illness has changed. Built with people living with PoTS, EDS, fibromyalgia, ME/CFS and long covid.

GUT, HORMONES AND CYCLE
Log digestive symptoms, food and bathroom habits to find out which foods are behind your IBS or GERD flare-ups. See how your symptoms, pain, migraine and mood change across each phase of your cycle, useful for PCOS, PMDD, endometriosis and menstrual migraine.

MEDICATION AND TREATMENTS
Log medication, supplements and treatments, then see whether they are working for your pain, migraine or mental health and whether they cause side effects. The medication tracker also sets reminders so you never miss a dose or a diary entry.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Symptoms, pain, migraine, mood, medication, exercise and diet in one health tracker, so you can find useful patterns instead of switching between apps.

- Fully customisable: record exactly what matters to you
- Insights that show what correlates with your symptoms
- Reports that turn months of symptom, pain and mental health logs into actionable insights
- Sync steps, sleep and heart rate from Apple Health and Fitbit
- Reminders, secure export, restore across devices, dark mode

PRIVATE AND SECURE
Your health data is encrypted. Export or delete it from within the app at any time. We will never sell your data.

MADE BY PEOPLE WHO UNDERSTAND
Created by people who live with health issues themselves, shaped by thousands of members of the chronic illness community. Our aim is to make symptom tracking simple, even on days when fatigue, pain, migraine or brain fog make everything harder.

WAYS PEOPLE USE BEARABLE
Symptom tracker & health diary
Migraine & headache tracker
Chronic Pain tracker
Mental health & mood tracker
Chronic illness & flare diary
IBS & IBD symptom tracker
PCOS, PMDD & cycle tracker
PoTS & EDS tracker
Medication tracker & reminders
